note: WHAT THE BOX IS SERVING. The closed word list is generated from this commit, not from the working tree, because between a commit and its deploy those describe different screens and the list is the only vocabulary permitted about a screen. NOT every served file can be fingerprinted this way: the server stamps a cache marker into construct.html as it serves it (server.js, so a returning browser cannot keep a stale script), which makes its served bytes 22 longer than its source by design. Hashing it would be a check that can only ever fail, so it is deliberately not listed here — it carries no screen labels either, they are all in construct.js. Captured by vps-access/scripts/uts-served-fingerprint.sh after every deploy, then `node tests/sweep-words.js --write`.
